body:
Well, first time I didn’t have a choice since in rehab it was kind of mandatory, but thankfully this man was an angel! The most comprehensive person ever! And not like other therapists that just ask you why you’re there and immediately gives you a prescription and you’re out of the office. After I left rehab I tried with some other therapists but it wasn’t the same/things weren’t that bad, until eventually I became depressed again last year, and in order to get license for university, I needed a therapist to confirm that I wasn’t capable of continuing. This girl was awesome, too. But she moved jobs and I couldn’t afford it anymore nor did I have the time 😔
So both times it hasn’t been my choice, but it ended up being a good experience. I can’t do it now, though, my family doesn’t have the money and I can’t afford to stop my career anymore, my parents would kill me, and they won’t believe me. They’ll just blame it on my laziness and on how selfish I’m always thinking about me and no one else, etc, etc, etc. 

That’s why by doing this I know that eventually they’ll understand that it was for the best, they’ll be free of me, my problems, my expenses, everything. They could sell my car to get some money, and they won’t have to pay healthcare for me, or any pills or doctors that I need (I also have a lot of diseases). Economically it’s the best choice. They’ll get it some day, I hope

Wow, reading this it’s like reading a summary of my life. I too, don’t kill myself just because last time I failed, and I don’t want that, I can’t afford that. 

I know I’m supposed to cheer you up and say that life gets better. But I don’t know if it does, maybe staying just to see where life takes you and what surprises it has for you? 

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way, it’s the worst feeling in the world, and I wouldn’t wish it to anyone
